name: St. Joseph County Board of Health
what_it_decides: Sets policy for the county health department and appoints the county health officer.
appointing_authorities: 7 seats appointed by the County Board of Commissioners; South Bend mayor (1 seat); Mishawaka mayor (1 seat)
notes: 2026 roster: all 7 filled seats appointed by the Commissioners; the two mayor seats listed vacant. Commissioner appointments were criticized in 2022-23 WVPE reports. Taxing power not stated in sources.

name: St. Joseph County Redevelopment Authority / Commission
appointing_authorities: County Board of Commissioners (members serve at its pleasure)
notes: From a search snippet only; membership size and legal form not verified.

name: Area Plan Commission of St. Joseph County
what_it_decides: Planning, rezoning and subdivision control for the unincorporated county and the towns of Lakeville, New Carlisle, North Liberty, Osceola and Roseland. Not South Bend or Mishawaka. Variances and special uses go to the separate Area Board of Zoning Appeals.
appointing_authorities: County Commissioners (2: an agricultural-interests and a citizen member); County Council (1 citizen member); County Surveyor (seat set by state law); North Liberty, New Carlisle and Osceola town councils (1 each); Lakeville and Roseland jointly through the Advisory Council on Town Affairs (1); school corporation superintendents (1)
notes: Nine members representing six member units (the county and five towns), under IC 36-7-4-202. The earlier description "county-wide zoning; approves redevelopment plans" was wrong: South Bend and Mishawaka are not members. A 2019 annual report still listed a South Bend mayoral appointee.

name: St. Joseph County Airport Authority
appointing_authorities: County Board of Commissioners (all four members; bipartisan)
notes: Taxing power not stated. A commissioner-appointed member (Kostielney) was named in 2022.

name: St. Joseph County Public Library Board of Trustees
appointing_authorities: St. Joseph County Commissioners (2); County Council (2); South Bend Community School Corporation board (2); presidents of the John Glenn and Union North (LaVille) school boards jointly (1)
notes: Trustees serve four-year terms, up to four consecutive. A 2024-25 dispute over seating a nominee was reported. Library districts levy property tax in Indiana (not verified in sources). Appointing split read from the library board page 2026-11-08; normally meets the 4th Monday at 4:15 pm.

name: Mishawaka-Penn-Harris Public Library Board of Trustees
appointing_authorities: School City of Mishawaka board (2); County Council (2); County Commissioners (2); Penn-Harris-Madison school board (1)
notes: Taxing power not stated on the board page. Meeting day conflict: the library page reads "third Thursday ... at 4 p.m." (gap-fill B; the page timed out on re-check 2026-11-08) while the city's 2025 appointing-authority disclosure says 2nd Thursday at 4. Both recorded; not resolved.

name: Transpo (South Bend Public Transportation Corporation) board
appointing_authorities: Mayor of South Bend (3); South Bend Common Council (4); Mayor of Mishawaka (1); Mishawaka Common Council (1)
notes: Typically meets the third Monday of the month at 4:00 p.m. at the Transpo administration and operations facility (some 2026 meetings on other days). Levy not found.

name: South Bend Redevelopment Commission
what_it_decides: Redevelopment and tax-increment decisions for the city.
appointing_authorities: Mayor (3 voting members); Common Council (2 voting members); mayor appoints a non-voting school board adviser
notes: From a city-page snippet only (confidence medium). Gap-fill B lead (not re-read 2026-11-08): the city boards page gives regular meetings on the second and fourth Thursdays at 9:30 a.m.; appointers not re-verified.

name: South Bend Board of Public Works and Safety
what_it_decides: City works and public-safety administration (statutory board).
appointing_authorities: Not in sources (IC 36-4-9-5: one board per city; a second-class city's council may split it into works and safety boards)
notes: South Bend's actual setup and membership were not researched; statute text may be outdated.

name: Housing Authority of South Bend Board of Commissioners
what_it_decides: Governs the housing authority (public housing and vouchers under federal rules).
notes: Seven per the audit report reviewed by the State Board of Accounts (2024). CONFLICT: 2023 news reports (95.3 MNC, ABC57) said all six commissioners had been appointed by the mayor. A 2023 council bill to split appointments was reported tabled. Both counts recorded; the audit is the more recent primary source.

notes: Meets Tuesdays at 10:00 am; one-year terms; the same members sit as the Utility Board (city 2025 disclosure). Number of members not confirmed.
